title: ulmus minor var. suberosa
intro: Ulmus minor var. suberosa, commonly known as Cork Elm or Smooth-leaved Elm, is a variety of elm tree native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ulmus minor var. suberosa include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
